---
id: env.def.environmental-law
type: definition
heading: Environmental Law
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

Any Commonwealth, state, territory or local law, regulation or legally binding order that regulates pollutants or the protection of land, water, air or living things, including the Protection of the Environment Operations Act 1997 (NSW), the Environment Protection Act 2017 (Vic), the Environmental Protection Act 1994 (Qld), the Contaminated Sites Act 2003 (WA) and the Environment Protection Act 1993 (SA), as amended or replaced.
